GameSave.title: GameSave
GameSave.description: Cloud auto-save state for Brasilândia: A Chave dos 1000 Elos, scoped to the authenticated player.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this save slot.

keysCollected.description: Total luminous keys collected toward the 1000 Elos goal.

mediumEnemiesCycle.description: Progress within the current 20-enemy dimensional portal cycle.

currentRealmIndex.description: Current dimensional plane index (0=Brasilândia, 1=Plano Espiritual, 2=Plano Divino, 3=Paraíso dos 20 Mundos).

bossesDefeated.description: Number of times Meyanga has been defeated.

satantiDowns.description: Number of times Satãnti Borô has been knocked down or defeated.

keyTimerMaxSeconds.description: Current maximum time window (seconds) to collect keys, starting at 30s + 10s per Satãnti Borô knockdown.

finalWarActive.description: Whether Guerra Final state was active.

secretUnlocked.description: Whether the 9th character '?' (1000 Elos) is unlocked.

highScore.description: Highest score achieved by the player.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the save was created (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest cloud auto-save (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/game_saves/{saveId}.description: Per-user cloud save state for Brasilândia: A Chave dos 1000 Elos.
